entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The primary human religion of Innistrad, centered on the archangel Avacyn, with close ties to the state and governed from Thraben.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An archangel who contained Innistrad's darkness, was imprisoned in the Helvault, freed, and then became corrupted.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The gothic plane of the Church of Avacyn.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: A Lunarch who knew the reason for Avacyn's absence and died during the Siege of Thraben.

entities.name: Macher
entities.description: Mikaeus's successor as Lunarch, killed early in Avacyn's madness.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker whose arrival on Innistrad led to the Helvault's destruction.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A cathar forced by Liliana to destroy the Helvault; later the host of Saint Traft's geist.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A silver prison where Avacyn was held.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker whose machinations drove Avacyn and most angels insane.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: An angel who headed the Flight of Goldnight, later deranged.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: An angel who led the Flight of Alabaster, later deranged.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Leader of the Flight of Herons, the most powerful angel left after the Travails, who protects humanity and is revered by the Sigardian Sect.

entities.name: Isobel
entities.description: An angel of the Flight of Alabaster who joined Avacyn's rampage and was slain by humans.

entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: The leader of the extinct Flight of Dusk, executed by Avacyn for a pact with a demon.

entities.name: Seeta
entities.description: A leader of members of the Lunarch Inquisition who were partly Eldrazified, calling themselves the sinpurged.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose influence most angels succumbed to; Sigarda did not.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A cult exposed to be controlling the Lunarch Council.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: A council of senior bishops that replaced the Lunarch after Mikaeus and Macher died, moved to Ollenbock after Thraben's destruction.

entities.name: Lunarch Inquisition
entities.description: A fanatical central branch of the Church that arose in the crisis of faith and died out after the Battle of Thraben.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: An order following the geist of Saint Traft and Thalia, protecting humanity even from itself.

entities.name: Sigardian Sect
entities.description: A branch of worship directed toward Sigarda, with a small-town character.

entities.name: Flight of Moonsilver
entities.description: Fanatical angels formed after Avacyn's madness who followed her crusade against humanity.

entities.name: Flight of Herons
entities.description: The only angelic flight to survive the corruption, led by Sigarda.

entities.name: Flight of Dusk
entities.description: An extinct flight dedicated to studying creatures of darkness, destroyed by Avacyn.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The period when Avacyn and her angels became corrupted and attacked humanity.

events.summary: Avacyn has not been seen for several seasons and darkness advances.
events.quote: However, the Archangel Avacyn had not been seen in several seasons

events.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault, freeing Avacyn.
events.quote: She forced the cathar Thalia to destroy the silver Helvault , where Avacyn was held, to reach one of her enemies .

events.summary: Avacyn and her angels become corrupted and turn on humanity.
events.quote: Convinced of the evil of humanity, they turned on those they had sworn to protect

events.summary: Avacyn is destroyed beneath one of her churches to prevent further extermination of mankind.
events.quote: Her crusades blazed a bloody path across this world until she was destroyed beneath one of her churches

events.summary: Isobel, driven mad, joins Avacyn's rampage and is slain by the humans she once protected.
events.quote: Later driven to madness, Isobel joined Avacyn's rampage against the people of Innistrad and was consequently slain by the humans she once protected.

events.summary: Avacyn executes Liesa for making a pact with a demon and destroys the Flight of Dusk.
events.quote: when she betrayed the angels by making a pact with a demon, an enraged Avacyn executed Liesa and destroyed the entire flight

events.summary: After her descent into madness, Avacyn forms the Flight of Moonsilver.
events.quote: After Avacyn's descent into madness, she formed the Flight of Moonsilver

events.summary: Lunarch Mikaeus dies in the Siege of Thraben and his successor Macher is killed early in Avacyn's madness.
events.quote: After Lunarch Mikaeus died during the Siege of Thraben , and his successor Macher was killed in the early days of Avacyn's madness

events.summary: Nahiri's machinations drive Avacyn and most angels insane, fragmenting the Church.
events.quote: Due to Nahiri 's machinations, Avacyn and most other angels became insane and began killing the people of Innistrad.

events.summary: The Order of Saint Traft forms shortly before the Battle of Thraben.
events.quote: The Order of Saint Traft came into being during the last part of the Travails , shortly before the Battle of Thraben .

events.summary: Sigarda resists Emrakul's influence and defends humanity, giving rise to the Sigardian Sect.
events.quote: Sigarda and the remnants of her Flight were of the few angels who never succumbed to Emrakul's influence

relations.quote: The central figure of the Church is Avacyn herself
